turns.content: Derive the V-band distance formula from the extinction-corrected distance modulus, using A_V=3.1 E(B-V).
Calculate the distances for a: M_V=8, m_V=8, E(B-V)=0; b: 8, 7, 0; and c: 8, 9, 0.
Now calculate d: M_V=8, m_V=7, E(B-V)=0.2; e: 7, 7, 0.2; and f: 7, 7, 0, retaining the V-band extinction correction.
Use the calculated distances to construct the requested strictly increasing subsequence. Include approximate values and note any equality that prevents a strict ordering of all six cases.
Check the extinction correction and any equal distances. Why can an equality not appear as a strict less-than step?
Report the final increasing sequence with the adopted distances.
